subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What degraded-state contract should Gateway expose during reload/restart so Control UI and `sessions.resolve` do not report healthy/missing-session while the runtime is not trustworthy?
rationale: The remaining fix spans Gateway readiness semantics, session RPC behavior, Control UI UX, restart recovery, and macOS launchd proof, and several valid compatibility-sensitive designs exist.

options.title: Gate session resolution on degraded readiness
options.body: Make `sessions.resolve` and related session RPCs return a retryable degraded/reloading response until the runtime/session graph is trustworthy, and teach Control UI to present that state.

options.title: Split core-ready and sidecar-ready states
options.body: Adopt the broader #78954 direction first, then map Control UI/session calls onto the selected readiness tier.

options.title: Limit to WebChat notice subset
options.body: Proceed only with the narrower #95154-style transcript notice for unresumable WebChat recovery and leave partial-reload readiness as separate product work.

recommendation.title: Gate session resolution on degraded readiness
recommendation.body: Make `sessions.resolve` and related session RPCs return a retryable degraded/reloading response until the runtime/session graph is trustworthy, and teach Control UI to present that state.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source history points to recent broad ownership across the Gateway/session readiness paths that need the product contract decision.
